2609.16053.title: Retrieval-Driven Memory Reconsolidation for Long-Term LLM Agents
2609.16053.paper_summary: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents operating over extended interactions. Existing memory systems primarily update memory when new information arrives, treating retrieval as the endpoint of memory access rather than a driver of memory evolution. Consequently, retrieval feedback is rarely exploited to reorganize memory for future access continuously. Moreover, most existing approaches rely on predefined memory structures together with fixed retrieval pipelines, limiting the agent's ability to organize and evolve its own memory autonomously. Inspired by memory reconsolidation in cognitive neuroscience, we propose \textbf{REALM}, a \textbf{r}econsolidation-\textbf{e}volution \textbf{a}gentic \textbf{l}ong-term \textbf{m}emory framework. It models long-term memory as a continual lifecycle by autonomously organizing memories into a heterogeneous cognitive graph, retrieving evidence via adaptively composed graph-search atoms, and continually reconsolidating memories based on retrieval feedback. REALM achieves an average accuracy of 75.97\% on LoCoMo and 65.11\% on LongMemEval, outperforming the strongest baselines by 7.17 and 1.31 points respectively. Ablation studies confirm that memory reconsolidation consistently boosts performance, with further analyses revealing that it progressively reorganizes related memory units into more coherent local structures for collective evidence recall and utilization during reasoning. These results suggest that retrieval-driven memory reconsolidation provides an effective mechanism for continually evolving long-term memory in LLM agents.
2609.16053.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶對於基於 LLM 的代理在長時間互動中至關重要。現有的記憶系統主要在新信息到達時更新記憶，將檢索視為記憶訪問的終點，而不是記憶演變的驅動力。因此，檢索反饋很少被利用來持續重組記憶以便未來訪問。此外，大多數現有的方法依賴於預定義的記憶結構以及固定的檢索管道，限制了代理自主組織和演變其自身記憶的能力。受到認知神經科學中記憶再鞏固的啟發，我們提出了 \textbf{REALM}，一個 \textbf{r}econsolidation-\textbf{e}volution \textbf{a}gentic \textbf{l}ong-term \textbf{m}emory 框架。它將長期記憶建模為一個持續的生命周期，通過自主將記憶組織成一個異質的認知圖，通過自適應組合的圖搜尋原子檢索證據，並根據檢索反饋持續再鞏固記憶。REALM 在 LoCoMo 上達到 75.97\% 的平均準確率，在 LongMemEval 上達到 65.11\%，分別超越最強基準 7.17 和 1.31 點。消融研究證實記憶再鞏固持續提升性能，進一步分析顯示它逐步將相關記憶單元重組成更具一致性的局部結構，以便在推理過程中進行集體證據回憶和利用。這些結果表明，基於檢索的記憶再鞏固為 LLM 代理持續演變長期記憶提供了一種有效的機制。
